confidence_notes: Malacca's Numbeo prices were updated 2 October 2026 and reflect 16 contributors. Meals, coffee and draft beer use its reported typical prices; cocktail and wine-glass estimates are inferred from beer and local wine pricing. Accommodation is a holistic estimate.
